name: SlideShowView
description: Represents the view in a slide show window.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Zoom
properties.description: Returns the zoom setting of the specified slide show window view as a percentage of normal size. Read-only.

properties.name: Slide
properties.description: Returns a Slide object that represents the slide that's currently displayed in the specified slide show window view. Read-only.

properties.name: PointerType
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of pointer used in the slide show. Read/write.

properties.name: State
properties.description: Returns or sets the state of the slide show. Read/write.

properties.name: AcceleratorsEnabled
properties.description: Determines whether shortcut keys are enabled during a slide show. Read/write.

properties.name: PresentationElapsedTime
properties.description: Returns the number of seconds that have elapsed since the beginning of the specified slide show. Read-only.

properties.name: SlideElapsedTime
properties.description: Returns the number of seconds that the current slide has been displayed. Read/write.

properties.name: LastSlideViewed
properties.description: Returns a Slide object that represents the slide viewed immediately before the current slide in the specified slide show view.

properties.name: AdvanceMode
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates how the slide show in the specified view advances. Read-only.

properties.name: PointerColor
properties.description: Returns a ColorFormat object that represents the pointer color for the specified presentation during one slide show. Read-only.

properties.name: IsNamedShow
properties.description: Determines whether a custom (named) slide show is displayed in the specified slide show view. Read-only.

properties.name: SlideShowName
properties.description: Returns the name of the custom slide show that's currently running in the specified slide show view. Read-only.

properties.name: CurrentShowPosition
properties.description: Returns the position of the current slide within the slide show that is showing in the specified view. Read-only.

properties.name: MediaControlsVisible
properties.description: Indicates whether the media controls are visible. Read-only.

properties.name: MediaControlsLeft
properties.description: Returns the distance, in points, from the left edge of the media control bounding box to the left edge of the Slide. Read-only.

properties.name: MediaControlsTop
properties.description: Returns the distance, in points, from the top edge of the media control bounding box to the top edge of the Slide object. Read-only.

properties.name: MediaControlsWidth
properties.description: Returns the width, in points, of the media control bounding box. Read-only.

properties.name: MediaControlsHeight
properties.description: Returns the height of the media control bounding box. Read-only.

properties.name: LaserPointerEnabled
properties.description: Returns True if the current slide show pointer is a laser pointer. This property is applicable only while the slide show is running. Read/write.

methods.name: DrawLine
methods.signature: DrawLine(BeginX As Single, BeginY As Single, EndX As Single, EndY As Single)
methods.description: Draws a line in the specified slide show view.

parameters.name: BeginX
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's starting point relative to the upper-left corner of the slide.

parameters.name: BeginY
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's starting point relative to the upper-left corner of the slide.

parameters.name: EndX
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's ending point relative to the upper-left corner of the slide.

parameters.name: EndY
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's ending point relative to the upper-left corner of the slide.

methods.name: EraseDrawing
methods.description: Removes lines drawn during a slide show by using either the DrawLine method or the pen tool.

methods.name: First
methods.description: Sets the specified slide show view to display the first slide in the presentation.

methods.name: Last
methods.description: Sets the specified slide show view to display the last slide in the presentation.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Displays the slide immediately following the slide that's currently displayed.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Shows the slide immediately preceding the slide that's currently displayed.

methods.name: GotoSlide
methods.description: Switches to the specified slide during a slide show. You can specify whether you want the animation effects to be rerun.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The number of the slide to switch to.

parameters.name: ResetSlide
parameters.description: Whether animation effects should be rerun when returning to the first slide. See Remarks for more information.

methods.name: GotoNamedShow
methods.description: Switches to the specified custom, or named, slide show during another slide show. When the slide show advances from the current slide, the next slide displayed will be the next one in the specified custom slide show, not the next one in current slide show.

parameters.name: SlideShowName
parameters.description: The name of the custom slide show to be switched to.

methods.name: EndNamedShow
methods.description: Switches from running a custom, or named, slide show to running the entire presentation of which the custom show is a subset. When the slide show advances from the current slide, the next slide displayed will be the next one in the entire presentation, not the next one in the custom slide show.

methods.name: ResetSlideTime
methods.description: Resets the elapsed time (represented by the SlideElapsedTime property) for the slide that's currently displayed to 0 (zero).

methods.name: GotoClick
methods.description: Plays an animation associated with a specified mouse click and any animations that follow on the slide.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the mouse click that initiates an animation.

methods.name: GetClickIndex
methods.description: Returns the index number of the current mouse click for an animation that is actively playing on a slide or has just finished.

methods.name: GetClickCount
methods.description: Returns the number of mouse clicks that are defined for a slide.

methods.name: FirstAnimationIsAutomatic
methods.description: Returns True if the current slide has an initial animation that runs automatically.

methods.name: Player
methods.description: Allows access to playback controls for the associated view in the current window.
